text: `Packing::from_occupancy` (`libsufr/src/build.rs`) ranks the bytes the text holds 0, 1, 2 in byte order and leaves every other byte at 0. Rank 0 is the smallest byte in the text: the sentinel `$` unless the text holds a smaller byte such as a `#` delimiter (sufr-b96ee1). Covering every byte normalize saw keeps an unseen byte from sharing rank 0. The width follows the count of distinct bytes, so a stray byte can halve the key (sufr-aa4802).
